# genesyscloud_routing_skill_users (Data Source)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/data-sources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Data source for listing the users assigned to a Genesys Cloud routing skill. Select the skill by ID or by name.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this data source. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/routing/skills](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-routing-skills)
* [GET /api/v2/routing/skills/{skillId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-routing-skills--skillId-)
* [GET /api/v2/routing/skills/{skillId}/users](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-routing-skills--skillId--users)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `routing:skill:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `routing`
* `routing:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "genesyscloud_routing_skill_users" "marketing_by_id" {
  skill_id = genesyscloud_routing_skill.marketing.id
}

data "genesyscloud_routing_skill_users" "marketing_by_name" {
  skill_name = "marketing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `skill_id` (String) ID of the routing skill. Exactly one of `skill_id` or `skill_name` must be set.
- `skill_name` (String) Name of the routing skill. Exactly one of `skill_id` or `skill_name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the users assigned to the routing skill.
